description: This script performs static analysis on TypeScript source files within a repository to detect channel-agnostic boundaries and violations. It imports utilities for file system operations, path handling, and TypeScript AST analysis, and defines functions to find violations related to channel-specific references, module specifiers, and special literals in code files.

methods.name: findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Analyzes content of a source file to find violations related to channel-specific references, import/export statements, and comparisons, based on configurable checks.

methods.name: findChannelCoreReverseDependencyViolations
methods.description: Wrapper around findChannelAgnosticBoundaryViolations to specifically check for core reverse dependency violations.

methods.name: findAcpUserFacingChannelNameViolations
methods.description: Checks for user-facing channel name references that are not module specifiers.

methods.name: findSystemMarkLiteralViolations
methods.description: Detects usage of hardcoded system mark literals in source files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that collects files and runs various boundary violation checks, printing failures and terminating with error if violations are found.
